text:
mara_cs: quick sync — Harbinger bring-up tomorrow. two asks: confirm quota assignments + surface any renewal risk if performance gaps show.

rafael_harbr: appreciated. renewal conversation scheduled in 3 weeks; they'd like assurance on peak performance and cost predictability.

jason_runtime: quota sheet updated (link sent to customer). planned capacity: base 100 qps, burst to 800 qps. fallback model available.

linda_sre: autoscale knobs I'll apply: aggressive scale up at 55% GPU util, scale down conservative (5m). add hot-shard detector.

omar_oncall: canary plan: small blast then gradual. i'll own oncall and escalation. will inject single-node fault to validate fallback.

mara_cs: capture feedback checklist for post-run to reduce renewal risk:
- did latency meet SLA under peak?
- any visible errors or truncation?
- was cost within expected window?
- clarity of failover behavior and timelines
Please keep answers short; i'll put in customer report.

rafael_harbr: good template. also ask if we can tag runs with customer-visible IDs for billing.

jason_runtime: will tag requests and include billing delta in report.

deploy-bot: deploy-complete: harbinger-pool v1.6 -> nodes:6

linda_sre: note during warmup: KV hit 80% after ~18m. recommend 30m warmup before canary.

omar_oncall: chaos injected mid-run; fallback engaged ~20s, no dropped requests. moving to cool-down.

mara_cs: thanks — i'll draft the customer note and attach telemetry snapshots. setting follow-up meeting with renewal owner depending on post-run signals. closing thread once report sent. :thumbsup:
